Commentary.Commentary: Right! That's all from this ODI series. Afghanistan take the series and also bag vital points for World Super League. The Afghanistan players pose with the trophy and celebrate. We thank you for your company for this brilliant series. For now, it is goodbye from our end. Take care and cheers!

The winning skipper, Asghar Afghan, starts by saying that he is pleased with the performance in the series. Tells that the winning combination is important and he is happy with the series win. Wants to continue the good performance in the coming games as well.

Ireland skipper, Andy Balbirnie, starts by praising the performance of Stirling and tells they don't have words to describe how well he has played. Tells no one could give him support. Says that there is a lot of cricket coming up for them and they need to be better than this.

Paul Stirling is named Player of the series for his fantastic performance in the series. He is disappointed that his team could not collect points from the series. He adds that they were in good positions in the match, but couldn't capitalize and finish the game off. Also remembers Roy Torrens, who passed away recently and adds that a lot of people are already missing him so much.

Rashid Khan is named the Player of the Match for his contribution with both bat and ball. He says that he is happy to win the award almost after 15 games. Tells that he tried to put pressure by bowling dot balls. Says in the last two games, he bowled a bit wide and it was easier for them to score. Wanted to bowl wicket-to-wicket in this game. Adds that he has been working hard on his batting. Tells that he backs himself to score the runs. Is pleased with the result. Hopes to get a chance higher up the order with the bat. Dedicates the award to his late mom and dad.
Stay tuned for the presentation!

Earlier in the game, after struggling early on, decent hands from Afghan, Naib and Rashid took the team above the score of 250. Mujeeb and Naveen, the number 10 and 11 of the team, hit a few lusty blows to take the team's score to 266. Ireland were impressive with the ball. They were hit in the first 2 overs but they pulled back things nicely with Young taking 3 in the Powerplay. The spinners then came into the attack and kept things really tight. Simi took a 3-fer. However, they gave away a little too many in the final 10 with the last 3 Afghan batters making handy contributions. Eventually, those runs from the last few overs became the difference.

The Afghan bowlers were superb throughout the game! Despite the onslaught from Stirling from one end, they kept their cool and kept things nice and tight. Rashid, who wasn't at his best in the first two games with the ball, shone like a diamond in this game. He picked up 4 wickets while Mujeeb and Naib got 2 and 1 respectively. Pacer Naveen got the last wicket and closed things for his side.

Chasing the total of 267, Ireland started nicely with Stirling going bang, bang from the start. McCollum and Balbirnie failed to get going and departed at the other end but Stirling continued. He made useful stands with the likes of Tector, Campher and Tucker. He got to his 12th ODI ton in the process and smashed 6 sixes and 9 boundaries. However, once he was dismissed, they lost the plot. With the asking rate going upwards, the Ireland batters failed to get going and kept losing their wickets. And eventually, they fell short by quite a few runs.

Handshakes all around and smiles in the Afghanistan camp. A fine, fine performance from Afghanistan as they whitewash Ireland in the 3-game series. Stirling's ton kept them in the game but once he was removed, things went down the barrel for them and eventually, the Afghan spinners stiffled them in the run chase to register a comfortable victory.

Flat and around off, pushed to mid on.

SIX! Stand and deliver here from Stirling. Nabi bowls it around off, it spins in, this time Stirling accounts for the spin and tonks it over mid-wicket for six more. 50 up for Ireland. 13 off the first 2 balls.
Looks to go big on the leg side this time but ends up missing it as the ball spins sharply after pitching on middle. Nabi has overstepped now. Free Hit for Stirling.
SIX! Stirling welcomes him with a biggie! Tossed up and outside off, Stirling dances down the track and powers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Bowling change. Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack now.
Full and wide outside off, slower one it is. Driven towards the point fielder for nothing.
Low full toss, pushed to mid off.
Fuller and wider outside off, driven down to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary. Stirling moves to 33. A length ball around off, Stirling whacks it through mid-wicket and finds the boundary.
Good length and around off, pushed towards short third man.
FOUR! BANG! Short ball on middle, Stirling nails the pull through mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Who will come out to bat now? Skipper Andy Balbirnie walks in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! This time the finger has gone up. Floated around off, it spins in and beats the inside edge of the bat. James wanted to defend but missed it. He gets hit on the pad. And a loud appeal follows. The finger goes up. McCollum goes to his partner at the other end. They take their time and think of the review. They eventually go for it but by the time McCollum signalled for it, the time to go for the review was over. He has to go. Later on, replays roll in and it shows that had he taken the review in time, he would've been still out in the middle as the ball was missing the leg pole by some distance.
Loud appeal for LBW but it is turned down. The impact was outside off and it looked short as well.

Floated around off, turns away from the batsman. Stirling looks to play on the off side but gets a top edge which runs away towards the third man region. They take three as the fielder chases and keeps the ball in play.
Flatter on middle, Stirling keeps it out on the off side.
On middle, kept out by Paul.
Flatter on middle, James sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Length ball around off, blocked out.
Back of a length and on off, blocked out.
SIX! POWERED ALL THE WAY! Naveen goes for another slower one. This is full, right in the slot. Stirling picks the ball early and hammers it over wide long on for a biggie.
Good length and around off, pushed to the cover fielder. Another slower one it was from Naveen.
Length ball around off, Stirling moves on the off side and flicks it towards the leg side.
FOUR! BOOM! Super shot from Stirling! Naveen offers width outside off and Stirling pounces on it. Stirling leans and drives it square through the off side for a boundary.
Short and wide again, McCollum looks to punch it on the off side but gets an inside edge.
Flatter and just outside off, McCollum looks to cut but misses.
On off, pushed to mid on.
Tossed up and outside off, Stirling looks to slog it on the leg side but ends up hitting it off the inner half. Goes to mid-wicket for one.
On off, blocked with straight bat.
Shortish and around off, punched to the cover fielder.
McCollum is up and running! Full and wide outside off, he creams it through the covers. Rashid chases it down well ahead of the ropes. Two taken. 8 off the over.

Good stop down the leg side by the keeper. A length ball angled in from middle, McCollum looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. Gurbaz dives to his left and does well to stop the ball going down to the fine leg fence.
Slower fuller ball around off, McCollum calmly defends it.
Good length and outside off, Stirling punches it towards the backward point fielder who fails to stop it cleanly. A single taken.
Landed around off on a length, kept out.
Good change of pace and Naveen gets away on the Free Hit ball. Bangs it short but rolls his finger and bowls it wide outside off. Stirling cannot reach out to it.
FOUR! SPANKED! Short and wide outside off, Stirling slaps it through backward point and finds the fence. Called no ball as well. Free Hit coming up.
Dot on the last ball and it is an excellent first over from Mujeeb. Flatter and outside off, McCollum keeps it out.
Quick run! Floats this one around middle and it turns away. Paul pokes it towards short third man for a quick single.
Another short ball around off, Paul backs away and punches it again. Finds the cover fielder again.
Flat and around off, kept out.
Short and wide, punched towards the cover fielder again.
Short ball around off to begin, Stirling punches it towards the cover fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mujeeb-Ur-Rahman it is.
Dot to end the first over. 5 off it. A good length ball around off, McCollum defends it off the front foot.
Misfield and a run! A length ball just outside off, Stirling punches it towards the cover fielder. Shah there fumbles and allows an easy single.
Length ball around off, kept out.
FOUR! NAILED THROUGH THE COVERS! Slower fuller ball outside off, Stirling powers it through the cover region for a boundary. He is off the mark in style.
Wide and outside off, Paul looks to slam it through the off side but he ends up hitting it off the toe end.

We are back for the chase. Both the umpires are out in the middle. The Afghan players are in a huddle near the fence. They now take the field and get to their respective fielding position. Paul Stirling strides out along with James McCollum to open the innings. Naveen-Ul-Haq to open the bowling for Afghanistan. Here we go..
Good start from Naveen. A length ball around off, it comes in but Stirling blocks it out nicely.
